entry.reason: Framing-template executable geometric reference framing_oracle.py (the oracle for below-timber framing of a flat-nailed ceiling): computes every timber rectangle for rooms.json and emits the JSON that implementations must match; a reference specification written in Python with only json, math and sys, imported by no owned source and by no product entry point, and not the W-layer implementation of the framing template (none exists yet); retained reference tooling, not a product-loaded module or current product entry point.
